bio: Anyukám Mondta is everything a good neighbourhood restaurant should be. It offers something to appeal to everyone, while prices cover a wide range to suit all occasions. Excellent produce is prepared with care, resulting in hearty, flavoursome dishes, and service is smooth, well-paced and comes with plenty of personality. Choose from homemade pizzas, refined modern Italian dishes and tempting daily specials – where you might find some Middle Eastern flavours too. The focaccia cooked in the wood-fired oven is a must....
